meta.title: Who to contact — screened, fetched homepages for the organisations named in the credits
meta.grain: one entry per organisation, matched to a credit string by the regexes it carries

states.verified: this script fetched it on the run that wrote this file — homepage 200, or robots.txt 200 where a bot challenge answers a datacentre IP
states.unknown: did not answer this run; NOT shipped, and never read as broken

not_linked.reason: national Bible Society — several UBS members publish editions containing the deuterocanonicals, so whether a Society contact sits inside the 66-book filter is a product ruling, not this script's
doctrine not established from published material — left out rather than guessed

meta.note: Hand-screened allowlist. eBible's own homeDomain/publicationURL fields are deliberately NOT used: a refresh of someone else's catalogue must not be able to put a publisher on this map.
